bullets.title: TheTrueSize.com
bullets.note: This is mind-blowing. Try taking the United States, or your own country, and moving it around, especially towards the poles. Play with it for a minute and you’ll get it. From the description: “Every map projection introduces distortion, and each has its own set of problems. One of the most common criticisms of the [Mercator map](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercator_projection) is that it exaggerates the size of countries nearer the poles (US, Russia, Europe), while downplaying the size of those near the equator (the African Continent). … This app was created by [James Talmage](https://twitter.com/jamestalmage) and [Damon Maneice](https://twitter.com/damaneice). It was inspired by an episode of [_The West Wing_](https://youtu.be/eLqC3FNNOaI) and an infographic by Kai Krause entitled ‘[The True Size of Africa](http://kai.sub.blue/images/True-Size-of-Africa-kk-v3.pdf).’ We hope teachers will use it to show their students just how big the world actually is.”

bullets.title: My 2018 interview with George Raveling
bullets.note: If you missed my first interview with legendary coach George Raveling, it’s one of the podcast’s greatest hits, according to listeners. We covered a lot, including how he came to possess the original copy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s “I Have a Dream” speech, how his practice team ended up beating the 1984 US Olympic Dream Team in basketball, his pivotal role in getting Michael Jordan signed to Nike (instead of Adidas), and much more. Also, huge congratulations to George on his new book (with a Michael Jordan preface!): [_What You’re Made For: Powerful Life Lessons from My Career in Sports_.](https://www.amazon.com/What-Youre-Made-Powerful-Lessons/dp/0593852974/) ​
